'''Thunder Mist''' is part of [[Leafhunter]]'s pack of [[wolf|wolves]].

==Activities==
Thunder Mist and Leafhunter's pack are contacted by [[Perrin Aybara]] when he tries to identify a scent. When the wolves recognize the scent, that of [[Darkhound]]s, they all break contact except for Leafhunter.{{ref/book|10|5}}
